note: Decision hints and provenance, not proof of validation; null/missing thresholds must not be treated as zero. Vendor-specific constraints override generic patterns.

patterns.relation: VIN bypass near power VIN/GND; switching path minimal; FB separated from SW
patterns.metric: pad-to-pad connection, hot-loop area, SW/FB geometry
patterns.threshold_source: vendor application note/current and EMC budget

when: device power pin with bypass cap

patterns.relation: min gap >=2.0mm to clock pin; no vias on clock input/output; respect crystal ground region
patterns.metric: gap at specified footprint/pad objects, trace via count
patterns.threshold_source: RD03 specific ESP32-S3 official PCB Layout Design guide
patterns.check: geometry if exact pins are mapped

patterns.relation: ESD near entry and with short proper return path, avoid surge routing through protected IC
patterns.check: topological check plus manual EMC review

patterns.relation: keep continuous GND reference beneath critical tracks; do not unintentionally split
place series termination at source if vendor requires; reserve escape corridors and reference plane
patterns.metric: pin fanout feasibility, series-R position, pair length/impedance

patterns.relation: reassess placement after critical fanout and congestion; preserve user edits
patterns.metric: weighted route risk and lock conflicts

patterns.relation: require independent electrical/topology/thermal/DFM and full DRC review
antenna edge keepout, RF matching and controlled impedance per specific vendor design
patterns.metric: keepout geometry and RF reference continuity

patterns.relation: functional proximity of electrode/AFE/RCAL and controlled noise coupling, without assumed guard dimensions
patterns.metric: signal path geometry and noise-risk zones
patterns.threshold_source: actual sensor topology, analog performance validation
patterns.check: human analog review until net mapping verified

when: via transition or return stitching needed
patterns.relation: assess via plus nearby return rather than minimizing total via count
patterns.metric: transition count, return stitching, plane void/copper neck
